update_script = '''import sqlite3

db_path = "world.db"
conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
cur = conn.cursor()

# Get all tables to find the right one
tables = [r[0] for r in cur.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'").fetchall()]

# Find which table has the booking
target_table = None
for t in tables:
    cols = [r[1] for r in cur.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({t})").fetchall()]
    if "booking_id" in cols and "seat_type" in cols:
        cur.execute(f"SELECT booking_id FROM {t} WHERE booking_id = ?", ("BK-B70889",))
        if cur.fetchone():
            target_table = t
            break

if target_table:
    # Update seat_type from aisle to window, change_fee = 0 (Business class = free changes)
    cur.execute(f"UPDATE {target_table} SET seat_type = ?, change_fee = ? WHERE booking_id = ?",
                ("window", 0, "BK-B70889"))
    conn.commit()
    
    # Verify the update
    cur.execute(f"SELECT seat_type, change_fee, status, cabin_class FROM {target_table} WHERE booking_id = ?", ("BK-B70889",))

    print(f"Updated successfully!")
    print(f"  Seat type: {row[0]}")
    print(f"  Change fee: ${row[1]}")
    print(f"  Status: {row[2]}")
    print(f"  Cabin class: {row[3]}")
else:
    print("Could not find booking table")

conn.close()
'''
